guarantees.claim: When parameter gen_pipeline is true, a_x_calc is assigned a_x_q and b_x_calc is assigned b_x_q; when gen_pipeline is false, a_x_calc is assigned a_x and b_x_calc is assigned b_x.

assumptions.claim: If gen_no_pipeline is selected, the design does not prevent SCA leakage caused by the new x input being multiplied with the previous b in the same cycle; it is assumed that either this leakage is acceptable or mitigated externally.
assumptions.risk: Secret data may leak through power/timing side-channels if the sequential dependency between a and b is not handled.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment warns about SCA leakage in no-pipeline mode, but no hardware mitigation is present; it is unclear whether a higher-level masking scheme covers this or if the leakage is an accepted trade-off.
uncertain_points.risk: Unmitigated SCA leakage could expose secret key material if the multiplier inputs carry secrets.

uncertain_points.claim: The parameter gen_pipeline that selects the mode is set outside this chunk; its value and the surrounding security context are not visible here.
uncertain_points.risk: If gen_pipeline is false and the design expects DPA resistance, a side-channel vulnerability may exist.
